description.value: Gladstone Brewing Co. is an award-winning craft brewery taproom housed in a former mechanic's garage in the heart of downtown Courtenay, recognized as BC Brewery of the Year and a consistent medal-winner at the BC Beer Awards and Canada Beer Cup. The venue features two distinct indoor spaces — the lively Brewers Bar and the intimate Engine Room — plus a large outdoor patio, serving coffee, brunch, scratch-made Mexican dishes, and pub classics alongside European lagers, Pacific Northwest pale ales, and experimental small-batch beers. It has grown into a community hub with regular live music and events, making it a natural stop for cyclists passing through the Comox Valley.
